g.text: Six deposited library records, in original source order. Values copied from the reviewed frozen table.
Largest-ten fraction = sum of the ten largest gene-row counts / total counts in that library. No gene names are ranked here.
Libraries are technical records; animal identities and independence remain unverified.
These QC panels do not estimate treatment effects or support functional inference. Original biological execution holds remain unchanged.
